Hymn 153: Lord, We Ask Thee Ere We Part
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: G Major
Composer: George Careless
Lyricist/Text Author: George Manwaring
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 153 titled "Lord, We Ask Thee Ere We Part" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in G Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by George Careless and the lyrics were written by George Manwaring.
